##### Project general facts
Breeze by Trace is a residential tower on Al Reem Island, conceived around the idea of effortless, uncomplicated living. The building rises from a sculpted podium with flowing, wave-patterned façades and arched glazed entrances, while the tower above is wrapped in layered balconies with warm accent lighting. The residential collection spans one, two, three and four-bedroom apartments, with retail units at ground level. Each layout is planned for practicality and natural light, giving residents generous, easy-to-use living space.

The amenity programme is organised around wellness, leisure and family life. A main swimming pool is joined by a dedicated children's pool, a landscaped yoga lawn and an open-air cinema for shared evenings outdoors. Fitness routines are covered by both an indoor gym and an external gym, while a steam room and sauna support rest and recovery. A multipurpose hall and a residents' lounge offer flexible settings for gatherings, and a children's play area with shaded equipment keeps younger residents engaged.

Interiors follow a calm, contemporary palette with refined finishes and light marble-effect flooring. Living areas open onto floor-to-ceiling glazing that draws in daylight and frames views of the surrounding skyline and waterways. Open-plan kitchens with sleek cabinetry flow into the dining and living spaces, and bedrooms are designed as quiet, light-filled retreats. The overall approach prioritises lasting comfort, practical layouts and a sense of ease in everyday use.

##### Location description and benefits
Al Reem Island is a master-planned residential and business district just off the coast of central Abu Dhabi, linked by bridges to the city centre and to Al Maryah Island, the capital's financial hub. The island combines high-rise living with waterfront promenades, mangrove-lined shores and landscaped parks, including Reem Central Park. Reem Mall, a major retail, dining and entertainment destination, sits on the island alongside everyday shops, cafés and services.

Daily life is supported by strong social infrastructure. Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi and Repton School are close at hand, and Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi on Al Maryah Island provides specialist healthcare nearby. Galleria Mall, Abu Dhabi Mall and Marina Square add further retail and dining options, while Shams Beach and the mangrove forest offer outdoor leisure. Downtown Abu Dhabi, Saadiyat Island and Zayed International Airport are reached by road without difficulty.

Al Reem Island is one of Abu Dhabi's designated investment zones, where international buyers can acquire freehold property. Its proximity to Al Maryah Island's offices, universities and major healthcare facilities supports steady demand from professionals and families seeking rental homes. The combination of waterfront living, established amenities and central connectivity positions the island as one of the capital's most sought-after addresses for both end users and investors.
